name: Font Squirrel Component

title.zh: Font Squirrel · 用字母样张挑字形

description.zh: 先看黑底样张，再进许可页核款式与嵌入范围。 以字母样张、分类、作者及文件格式浏览的字体资源库，部分下载链接跳往原字厂或 Fontspring。本次查看 Acherus Grotesque 的样张和完整 Desktop/Webfont EULA，具体款式、使用人数、嵌入与字形产品限制需按该款核对；未取得字体文件，整体价格和其他字体授权仍待分别确认。
description.en: A font resource library organized by alphabet specimens, classification, designer, and file format, with some download links leading to a foundry or Fontspring. This visit examined Acherus Grotesque specimens and the full Desktop/Webfont EULA. Styles, user counts, embedding, and letterform-product restrictions require font-specific checks; no font file has been obtained, and overall pricing and other font permissions remain unverified.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Font Squirrel (https://www.fontsquirrel.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 先看黑底样张，再进许可页核款式与嵌入范围。

Visual details from source observation: 我们在首页先看到 Acherus、Intro Rust 和 Source Sans Pro 的字母样张，再到 Popular 比较无衬线与窄体字形。建议开 Acherus 详情，先看黑底白字样张的比例与字距，再从 License 读该款条款，下载按钮会转到 Fontspring。具体款式、使用人数与网页嵌入各有授权范围，选定后分别核对；本次没有取得字体文件。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
